segments.text: Greetings and welcome to the second week of this MOOC introduction to bio risk management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到慕课“生物风险管理导论”的第二周。

segments.text: In this week I will be discussing the concept of risk assessment.
segments.zh: 这一周我将讨论风险评估的概念。

segments.text: We will be discussing the various terminologies associated with risk assessment such as accident, incident
segments.zh: 我们会讨论与风险评估相关的各种术语，比如事故、事件，

segments.text: as well as specific terminologies such as adequacy and the importance of microbial risk assessment.
segments.zh: 以及“充分性”这样的具体术语，还有微生物风险评估的重要性。

segments.text: Welcome back to the second week of this MOOC introduction to bio risk management.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到慕课“生物风险管理导论”的第二周。

segments.text: I hope you have been making good progress.
segments.zh: 希望大家进展顺利。

segments.text: As this MOOC progresses, we continuously improve the quality of the content based on your comments and suggestions.
segments.zh: 随着本慕课的推进，我们会根据大家的意见和建议不断改进内容质量。

segments.text: I look forward to receiving these comments and suggestions in the forums.
segments.zh: 期待在论坛中收到这些意见和建议。

segments.text: Today's lecture will focus on risk assessment.
segments.zh: 今天这一讲的重点是风险评估。

segments.text: I will introduce you to the concepts of hazards and risks.
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍危害和风险的概念。

segments.text: And this will then progress on to the next lecture module, which will focus on risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 之后会进入下一讲模块，重点讲风险缓解。

segments.text: Now, as a bio risk manager, you must be aware of the multiple risks which are present in a laboratory setting.
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，你必须了解实验室环境中存在的多种风险。

segments.text: These extend beyond biological risks and these hazards can compromise your laboratory work as well as your safety.
segments.zh: 这些风险不限于生物风险，而且这些危害会损害你的实验室工作和你的安全。

segments.text: As a competent bio risk manager, you must assess the risks associated with the hazards,
segments.zh: 作为一名称职的生物风险管理者，你必须评估与各种危害相关的风险，

segments.text: with the primary objective of minimizing the likelihood of a breach of containment.
segments.zh: 首要目标是把发生防护失效的可能性降到最低。

segments.text: In this module, I will introduce you to the concepts of hazards and risks.
segments.zh: 在本模块中，我将向大家介绍危害和风险的概念。

segments.text: I want you to understand how a process involving a biological agent, a laboratory process to be specific,
segments.zh: 我希望大家理解涉及生物因子的过程，具体来说是实验室过程，

segments.text: increases the likelihood and consequence of a particular event.
segments.zh: 如何提高某一事件的可能性和后果。

segments.text: And that event focuses on the breach of containment and the subsequent exposure of the laboratory personnel
segments.zh: 而这一事件关注的是防护失效，以及随之而来的实验室人员

segments.text: and the community to the biological agent.
segments.zh: 和社区对生物因子的暴露。

segments.text: I will introduce you to the process of hazard identification and risk assessment
segments.zh: 我将向大家介绍危害识别和风险评估的过程，

segments.text: and introduce you to specific terms such as residual risk, accident and incident.
segments.zh: 并介绍剩余风险、事故、事件等具体术语。

segments.text: Each of these terms has a very specific definition.
segments.zh: 这些术语都有非常明确的定义。

segments.text: These are your learning outcomes.
segments.zh: 以下是学习成果。

segments.text: You should be able to define and describe the terms hazard and risk,
segments.zh: 你应当能够定义和描述“危害”和“风险”这两个术语，

segments.text: describe how laboratory processes increase the level of risk,
segments.zh: 描述实验室过程如何提高风险水平，

segments.text: perform a hazard identification and risk assessment,
segments.zh: 开展危害识别和风险评估，

segments.text: and define the terms residual risk, accident and incident.
segments.zh: 并定义剩余风险、事故和事件这几个术语。

segments.text: Now, in this lecture module, I have introduced you to the process via a case study.
segments.zh: 在本讲模块中，我通过一个案例研究向大家介绍这个过程。

segments.text: We will undertake a process, a very simple process,
segments.zh: 在下一讲进入更复杂的案例研究之前，

segments.text: before we move on to more complex case studies in the next lecture.
segments.zh: 我们先来做一个非常简单的过程分析。

segments.text: The first term which you must understand is the term incident.
segments.zh: 你必须理解的第一个术语是“事件”。

segments.text: An incident is an event. Both accidents and incidents are events.
segments.zh: 事件是一种事态。事故和事件都是事态。

segments.text: They occur within a spatial and temporal framework.
segments.zh: 它们都发生在特定的空间和时间框架内。

segments.text: However, an incident has a potential to cause harm, but it does not necessarily cause harm.
segments.zh: 不过，事件具有造成危害的可能性，但并不一定造成危害。

segments.text: This can be in the case of a near miss.
segments.zh: 这可以是“险肇”的情况。

segments.text: For instance, you are working in the laboratory with a beaker full of sulfuric acid
segments.zh: 例如，你在实验室里拿着一烧杯硫酸工作，

segments.text: and you spill the acid, but just in time to avoid the spill.
segments.zh: 你把酸洒了，但及时避开了。

segments.text: So you spill the acid, but you step back immediately and acid falls on the floor.
segments.zh: 也就是说你洒了酸，但立刻后退，酸落在了地上。

segments.text: Now, this is an example of an incident. It has not caused an accident,
segments.zh: 这就是事件的一个例子。它没有造成事故，

segments.text: but it has the potential for causing harm in the form of a burn injury.
segments.zh: 但有造成烧伤这类危害的可能性。

segments.text: An accident is an unintended event giving rise to harm.
segments.zh: 事故是导致危害的非预期事态。

segments.text: Now, for example, you have the same case, you have sulfuric acid on the table,
segments.zh: 例如，同样的情况，桌上有硫酸，

segments.text: you spill it and then you have a burn injury on your skin.
segments.zh: 你把它洒了，结果皮肤被烧伤。

segments.text: That constitutes an accident.
segments.zh: 这就构成事故。

segments.text: There was no intention to spill the acid on your skin.
segments.zh: 并没有把酸洒到皮肤上的意图。

segments.text: However, it occurred, so it is unintended.
segments.zh: 但它确实发生了，所以是非预期的。

segments.text: We now move on to the definition of hazard.
segments.zh: 下面我们来看“危害”的定义。

segments.text: A hazard is a source situation or act with a potential for causing harm.
segments.zh: 危害是具有造成危害可能性的来源、情形或行为。

segments.text: A very common example is your vehicle itself.
segments.zh: 一个很常见的例子就是你的车。

segments.text: You are in your vehicle, your car or your truck, in your park, in your garage.
segments.zh: 你坐在车里，你的轿车或卡车停在停车场或车库里。

segments.text: The truck itself is not a hazard,
segments.zh: 卡车本身不是危害，

segments.text: but when you begin to move this truck across the parking lot into the main street
segments.zh: 但当你开着这辆卡车穿过停车场驶入主干道，

segments.text: and onto the highway, the hazard is manifest due to a process.
segments.zh: 再上高速公路时，危害就因为一个过程而显现出来。

segments.text: And these are some of the hazards in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 实验室里有这样一些危害。

segments.text: You have theft, you can have fire hazards, radioactive hazard,
segments.zh: 有盗窃，还可能有火灾危害、放射性危害、

segments.text: ergonomic hazard slipping, as well as the radioactive
segments.zh: 人体工效学方面的滑倒危害，以及放射性

segments.text: and biological hazards and electrical hazards.
segments.zh: 和生物危害、电气危害。

segments.text: These are the hazards which you encounter in a standard laboratory.
segments.zh: 这些就是你在标准实验室中会遇到的危害。

segments.text: Now, we move on to the concept of risk.
segments.zh: 下面我们来看风险的概念。

segments.text: Risk is the combination of the probability of occurrence of harm
segments.zh: 风险是危害发生概率

segments.text: and the severity of that harm.
segments.zh: 与该危害严重程度的组合。

segments.text: I will define and describe this in detail with an example.
segments.zh: 我会结合一个例子详细定义和说明。

segments.text: A risk focuses on probability and severity.
segments.zh: 风险关注的是概率和严重程度。

segments.text: Probability implies likelihood.
segments.zh: 概率意味着可能性。

segments.text: What is the likelihood of the event?
segments.zh: 这一事件发生的可能性有多大？

segments.text: And severity is focused on the possible consequences of that event.
segments.zh: 严重程度关注的是该事件可能造成的后果。

segments.text: For instance, if you are working with a biological agent,
segments.zh: 例如，如果你处理某种生物因子，

segments.text: what is the likelihood of that biological agent causing harm to the laboratory workers
segments.zh: 这种生物因子对实验室工作人员或社区

segments.text: or the community?
segments.zh: 造成危害的可能性有多大？

segments.text: Obviously, it will be higher in the case of the laboratory environment
segments.zh: 显然，在实验室环境中，

segments.text: where you work within a confined space.
segments.zh: 由于你在受限空间内工作，可能性会更高。

segments.text: However, the consequences will be similar to the public
segments.zh: 不过，对公众和对实验室工作人员而言，

segments.text: as well as to the laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 后果是相似的。

segments.text: If the biological agent were to be released into a public space,
segments.zh: 如果这种生物因子被释放到公共场所，

segments.text: it would cause harm to the community,
segments.zh: 它会对社区造成危害，

segments.text: which is equivalent to the harm that would be caused in a laboratory working environment.
segments.zh: 其程度相当于在实验室工作环境中造成的危害。

segments.text: So, the consequences may be similar,
segments.zh: 因此，后果可能相似，

segments.text: but the likelihood changes based on the process.
segments.zh: 但可能性会因过程而变化。

segments.text: Let us delve into this with an example.
segments.zh: 我们用一个例子来深入探讨。

segments.text: By risk is the combination of the probability of the occurrence of the harm
segments.zh: 生物风险是危害发生概率

segments.text: and the severity of that harm
segments.zh: 与该危害严重程度的组合，

segments.text: where the source of harm is a biological agent.
segments.zh: 其中危害的来源是生物因子

segments.text: Potoxin.
segments.zh: 或毒素。

segments.text: So, this redefines the risk factor in terms of the bio-risk.
segments.zh: 这样就从生物风险的角度重新定义了风险因素。

segments.text: Now, hazards evolve into risks.
segments.zh: 危害会演变成风险。

segments.text: As I mentioned to you in the example of the vehicle,
segments.zh: 正如我在车辆的例子中提到的，

segments.text: your vehicle parked in your parking lot or in your garage does not pose a risk,
segments.zh: 停在停车场或车库里的车不构成风险，

segments.text: but the very fact that you move the vehicle from the parking lot
segments.zh: 但正是因为你把车从停车场开到

segments.text: into an unsafe environment, which is the highway or the freeway,
segments.zh: 不安全的环境中，也就是高速公路或快速路上，

segments.text: increases the level of risk.
segments.zh: 风险水平才提高了。

segments.text: The hazard evolves into a risk.
segments.zh: 危害演变成了风险。

segments.text: Now, in the laboratory setting, laboratory procedures,
segments.zh: 在实验室环境中，实验室操作程序、

segments.text: shipping of biological agents, theft, and breach of containment,
segments.zh: 生物因子的运输、盗窃和防护失效，

segments.text: all are risks which are posed by the hazard
segments.zh: 都是由危害带来的风险，

segments.text: that is essentially the biological agent in itself.
segments.zh: 而这种危害本质上就是生物因子本身。

segments.text: If you have developed this analogy or this example for you,
segments.zh: 为了说明这个类比或例子，

segments.text: let us assume that we isolated a microbe from the soil,
segments.zh: 假设我们从土壤中分离出一种微生物，

segments.text: but we don't know what identity is.
segments.zh: 但不知道它是什么。

segments.text: We culture the microbe in the lab,
segments.zh: 我们在实验室里培养这种微生物，

segments.text: and then we move on to the introduction of new genes.
segments.zh: 然后开始导入新基因。

segments.text: We introduce new genes into this microbe,
segments.zh: 我们向这种微生物中导入新基因，

segments.text: and we increase the culture volume in the fermenter.
segments.zh: 并在发酵罐中增加培养体积。

segments.text: So, from a small petri plate, which is about 20 cc of media,
segments.zh: 于是从大约20 cc培养基的小培养皿，

segments.text: we move on to a 25 liter fermenter with liquid culture.
segments.zh: 转到25升的液体培养发酵罐。

segments.text: So, now we have up the volume, we increase the volume.
segments.zh: 这样我们就把体积提上去了，增加了体积。

segments.text: Then we inject this microbe into mice
segments.zh: 然后我们把这种微生物注射到小鼠体内，

segments.text: to check whether it's pathogenic or non-pathogenic.
segments.zh: 以检验它是否具有致病性。

segments.text: This is a laboratory test or laboratory procedure.
segments.zh: 这是一项实验室试验或实验室操作。

segments.text: And now there is a potential for transmission from the mice
segments.zh: 现在就存在从小鼠

segments.text: into the laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 传播给实验室工作人员的可能。

segments.text: So, as you can see, a process,
segments.zh: 可以看到，一个过程，

segments.text: a simple process of increasing the culture volume
segments.zh: 一个简单的增加培养体积

segments.text: and then infecting another host has increased
segments.zh: 再感染另一种宿主的过程，就提高了

segments.text: the risk of accidental release
segments.zh: 这种生物因子

segments.text: of this particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 意外释放的风险。

segments.text: You may also want to look at another risk
segments.zh: 你可能还想从生物安全和生物安保的角度

segments.text: from the biosafety and biosecurity perspective,
segments.zh: 考虑另一种风险，

segments.text: which is the risk of theft of this particular sample
segments.zh: 也就是该样本被盗的风险，

segments.text: and the risk of release of the data
segments.zh: 以及关于通过动物宿主感染人类宿主的

segments.text: pertaining to infection of human hosts via the animal host.
segments.zh: 数据外泄的风险。

segments.text: Now, this can pose a potential biosecurity risk
segments.zh: 这可能构成潜在的生物安保风险，

segments.text: as the information about transmission
segments.zh: 因为关于从动物宿主向人类宿主

segments.text: from the animal to the human host
segments.zh: 传播的信息

segments.text: can be misused with nefarious or bad intent.
segments.zh: 可能被出于不法或恶意目的滥用。

segments.text: Okay, and with the risk of accidental release,
segments.zh: 除了意外释放的风险之外，

segments.text: we have also the risk of the consequences increase
segments.zh: 随着实验的推进，

segments.text: as the experiment progresses.
segments.zh: 后果加重的风险也在增加。

segments.text: As a virus manager, we focus on the hazard identification.
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，我们关注危害识别。

segments.text: Then we conduct a risk assessment, risk control,
segments.zh: 然后我们开展风险评估、风险控制，

segments.text: and we assess the residual risk before we make a decision
segments.zh: 并在决定是否继续该实验之前

segments.text: whether we want to proceed with that experiment or not.
segments.zh: 评估剩余风险。

segments.text: So, hazard identification involves identification
segments.zh: 危害识别包括识别

segments.text: of the hazards in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 实验室中的各种危害。

segments.text: In our case, as virus managers,
segments.zh: 就我们生物风险管理者而言，

segments.text: we focus on the potential biological hazards.
segments.zh: 我们关注潜在的生物危害。

segments.text: We then conduct a risk assessment,
segments.zh: 然后我们开展风险评估，

segments.text: which I will demonstrate to you via case study,
segments.zh: 我会通过案例研究为大家演示，

segments.text: and then we focus on risk control
segments.zh: 接着我们关注风险控制，

segments.text: or what is termed as risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 也就是所谓的风险缓解。

segments.text: This will be the subject of our next lecture
segments.zh: 这将是我们下一讲的主题，

segments.text: in which we focus on risk control.
segments.zh: 在那一讲中我们重点讲风险控制。

segments.text: And finally, we identify a residual risk
segments.zh: 最后，我们识别剩余风险，

segments.text: where we determine residual risk
segments.zh: 确定剩余风险，

segments.text: and then make decisions regarding the process.
segments.zh: 然后就该过程作出决策。

segments.text: So, if the residual risk is too high,
segments.zh: 如果剩余风险过高，

segments.text: a laboratory virus manager may advise the management.
segments.zh: 实验室生物风险管理者可以向管理层建议：

segments.text: Please do not work with this particular biological agent
segments.zh: 请不要处理这种生物因子，

segments.text: because the facilities are not adequate.
segments.zh: 因为设施条件不充分。

segments.text: Now, the process of recognizing that a hazard exists
segments.zh: 认识到存在某种危害这一过程

segments.text: and defining its characteristics
segments.zh: 并明确其特性，

segments.text: is termed as hazard identification.
segments.zh: 就称为危害识别。

segments.text: So, hazard identification basically focuses on identifying
segments.zh: 因此，危害识别基本上就是把生物因子

segments.text: or categorizing a biological agent
segments.zh: 识别或划分到

segments.text: into its respective risk group.
segments.zh: 相应的危险度等级。

segments.text: And this constitutes the process of defining
segments.zh: 这也就构成了明确

segments.text: its characteristics.
segments.zh: 其特性的过程。

segments.text: So, in order to identify a hazard,
segments.zh: 要识别一种危害，

segments.text: you need a priori information or prior information
segments.zh: 你需要关于该生物因子的

segments.text: pertaining to that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 先验信息或既有信息。

segments.text: And this can be found in the pathogen safety data sheets,
segments.zh: 这些可以在病原体安全数据表中找到，

segments.text: which I will share with you via a link.
segments.zh: 我会通过链接分享给大家。

segments.text: So, the pathogen safety data sheets
segments.zh: 病原体安全数据表

segments.text: do not constitute a written document.
segments.zh: 不是一份书面文件。

segments.text: It's a website which is being designed and developed
segments.zh: 它是加拿大政府设计和建设的

segments.text: by the government of Canada,
segments.zh: 一个网站，

segments.text: and it's a very useful website for biarisk managers.
segments.zh: 对生物风险管理者来说非常有用。

segments.text: We now move on to biarisk management.
segments.zh: 下面我们来看生物风险管理。

segments.text: So, biarisk management focuses on the process
segments.zh: 生物风险管理关注的是

segments.text: of evaluating the biarisks
segments.zh: 评价生物风险、

segments.text: and taking into account the adequacy
segments.zh: 考虑任何现有控制措施的

segments.text: of any existing controls
segments.zh: 充分性，

segments.text: and deciding whether or not the biarisk is acceptable.
segments.zh: 并判断该生物风险是否可接受的过程。

segments.text: So, these are multiple steps.
segments.zh: 这包含多个步骤。

segments.text: You first evaluate the biarisk.
segments.zh: 你先评价生物风险。

segments.text: You take into account the adequacy
segments.zh: 你考虑你们设施中

segments.text: of any existing controls
segments.zh: 可能已有的任何控制措施的

segments.text: which may be present at your facility,
segments.zh: 充分性，

segments.text: and then you decide whether the biarisk
segments.zh: 然后判断该生物风险

segments.text: is acceptable or not.
segments.zh: 是否可接受。

segments.text: Biarisk controls focuses on actions implementing
segments.zh: 生物风险控制措施关注的是落实

segments.text: biarisk management decisions,
segments.zh: 生物风险管理决策的各项行动，

segments.text: and we will focus on this in a specific lecture
segments.zh: 我们会在专门讲控制措施的

segments.text: on controls.
segments.zh: 那一讲中讨论这个问题。

segments.text: These are the five controls.
segments.zh: 这就是五种控制措施。

segments.text: They are elimination, substitution,
segments.zh: 它们是消除、替代、

segments.text: engineering controls, administrative controls,
segments.zh: 工程控制、管理控制

segments.zh: 最后，他们通过安全的计算机或安全的互联网连接

segments.zh: 这是对这些过程的详细说明。

segments.zh: 同时进行文件记录并传回医院。

segments.text: The first step as a BiRisk Manager is to look at adequacy.
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，第一步是考察充分性。

segments.text: Now, suppose I receive that sample in a lab
segments.zh: 假设我在一个实验室收到那份样本，

segments.text: in which I do not have what I mentioned earlier,
segments.zh: 而实验室里没有我前面提到的

segments.zh: 生物安全柜。

segments.zh: 那我基本上就不能处理那份样本，

segments.zh: 因为当我打开样本并进行处理时，

segments.zh: 会产生气溶胶。

segments.text: So, in this case, the case of adequacy must be addressed.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，必须解决充分性的问题。

segments.zh: 下面我们来看其他方面。

segments.zh: 我们的设施是否充分？

segments.zh: 我们是否有适当的仪器设备？

segments.text: Are our personnel competent?
segments.zh: 我们的人员是否胜任？

segments.zh: 他们是否需要额外培训？

segments.text: Do we have the SOPs and the means for disposal
segments.zh: 我们是否有处置生物废物或危险废物的

segments.text: of biological waste or hazardous waste?
segments.zh: 标准操作规程和手段？

segments.text: And do we have contingency planning
segments.zh: 发生防护失效时

segments.text: in the event of a breach of containment?
segments.zh: 我们是否有应急计划？

segments.text: These are factors which must be looked into in detail
segments.zh: 这些都是你在开展风险评估时

segments.text: when you conduct your risk assessment.
segments.zh: 必须详细考察的因素。

segments.text: So, we look at our existing controls
segments.zh: 作为风险评估的第一步，

segments.text: as the first step of risk assessment.
segments.zh: 我们先考察现有的控制措施。

segments.text: We then move on to specific questions.
segments.zh: 然后我们进入一些具体问题。

segments.text: So, risks we are attempting to assess.
segments.zh: 下面是我们要评估的各种风险。

segments.text: So, the first risk may be biosafety associated.
segments.zh: 第一种风险可能与生物安全有关。

segments.zh: 即实验室人员接触

segments.zh: 生物因子的风险。

segments.zh: 第二种风险是社区

segments.text: to the biological agent.

segments.zh: 一级防护和二级防护的概念。

segments.text: So, in the first case is our primary containment adequate.
segments.zh: 第一种情况是我们的一级防护是否充分。

segments.text: In the second case is our secondary containment adequate.
segments.zh: 第二种情况是我们的二级防护是否充分。

segments.text: We may also want to look at the biosecurity risk,
segments.zh: 我们可能还要考察生物安保风险，

segments.text: risk of intentional release of the biological agent.
segments.zh: 也就是生物因子被故意释放的风险。

segments.text: So, someone may decide to steal that biological asset
segments.zh: 有人可能决定窃取这项生物资产，

segments.text: and use it for their own intended purpose
segments.zh: 用于自己的目的，

segments.text: which may be nefarious.
segments.zh: 而这种目的可能是不法的。

segments.text: With the intent to cause harm.
segments.zh: 带有造成危害的意图。

segments.text: So, let's look back at our example or case study
segments.zh: 我们回头看我们的例子或案例研究，

segments.text: and risk assessment is a step by step process.

segments.zh: 我们在每个步骤都开展风险评估。

segments.zh: 第一步是运输、储存，

segments.text: and then we receipt of the sample and storage
segments.zh: 然后是样本的接收和储存、

segments.text: and processing of the sample and waste management.
segments.zh: 样本的处理以及废物管理。

segments.text: So, the risk of release of the biological agent
segments.zh: 生物因子释放的风险，

segments.text: and risk of exposure of the personnel
segments.zh: 以及人员和社区

segments.text: as well as the community to the biological agent

segments.text: must be addressed at each stage or each step of the process.
segments.zh: 都必须在这个过程的每个阶段或每个步骤加以考察。

segments.zh: 我们考察的是实验室人员在处理样本过程中

segments.zh: 接触生物因子的风险。

segments.zh: 即实验室人员在某一过程中

segments.text: to the biological agent during.

segments.text: And we look at the consequence and the likelihood.

segments.zh: 如果后果轻微，我们就标为低风险。

segments.text: If it is very high, you have a scale

segments.text: So, this is low, moderate, high, very high.
segments.zh: 分为低、中、高、极高。

segments.text: So, we have clearly indicated scale.
segments.zh: 我们有明确标示的标度。

segments.zh: 例如，实验室人员在提取RNA这类操作中

segments.text: to the biological agent during, for instance, extraction of RNA.
segments.zh: 接触生物因子的风险。

segments.text: and the consequences will be moderate
segments.zh: 而后果则是中等，

segments.text: because RNA is not infectious.

segments.zh: 不过，如果同一位实验室工作人员

segments.text: in culture of the live virus in a liquid medium,
segments.zh: 参与在液体培养基中培养活病毒，

segments.text: the consequence will be very high
segments.zh: 后果就会非常严重，

segments.zh: 而该样本意外释放

segments.text: or spilled accidentally also is very high.

segments.zh: 这就是我们在这个案例研究过程中

segments.text: during the course of this case study.

segments.zh: 我们还必须考察总体风险矩阵。

segments.zh: 我用不同的颜色标示，

segments.text: for your reference.
segments.zh: 供大家参考。

segments.zh: 对于总体风险矩阵，

segments.text: to the biological agent and the risk of the theft
segments.zh: 以及从生物安保角度看

segments.text: of the sample or the intentional release
segments.zh: 样本被盗或被故意释放的

segments.text: in terms of the biosecurity aspect.

segments.zh: 接收和储存过程中风险也较高。

segments.text: It drops and during processing of the sample,
segments.zh: 之后风险下降，在样本处理、

segments.zh: 处置和数据传输过程中，风险非常低。

segments.zh: 所以随着样本被处理，风险水平逐步下降。

segments.zh: 样本一旦被灭活，

segments.text: the thief can no longer use it
segments.zh: 盗取者就无法再用它

segments.text: for intended harm or intentional release

segments.zh: 因为它已经没有生物活性了。

segments.zh: 这时我们必须作出决定。

segments.zh: 也就是风险缓解。
